text:
Here are the strongest 3-in-1 Qi2 stands from the sources I found. Your iPhone model matters most, because the fast 25W rate only works on certain iPhones.

**Best value for 25W: ESR CryoBoost 3-in-1 Qi2.2 (about $82 with a code)**
- The Dealectric listing shows $99.99 list, and an 18% partner code (PARTNER18) took $17.99 off in a cart test on 2026-10-23. Checkout has the final word, so confirm the price when you buy.
- The stand has an active cooling fan and a Qi2.2 phone pad. It also includes a 50W adapter and a 12-month warranty (24 months with free registration).
- 25W applies only to the iPhone 17 series, 16 Pro Max, and 16 Plus on iOS 26. iPhone Air, 16, and 16 Pro get 20W, and older iPhones get 15W.
- Buy: https://dealectric.com/go/esr-cryoboost-3-in-1-qi2-2-25w-stand
- Source: https://dealectric.com/esr-cryoboost-3-in-1-qi2-2-25w-stand
- Note: Dealectric earns a commission on purchases through this link. The Amazon listing for the same model is $100 per WIRED.

**Best overall: Belkin 3-in-1 Qi2 Charging Stand (about $90–$98)**
- WIRED's pick. It charges the iPhone at up to 15W, can fast-charge the Apple Watch Series 7 or newer, and has a spot for AirPods. The base tilts the iPhone for StandBy mode.
- WIRED lists $98 direct, $90 on Amazon, and $80 at Best Buy, with a 2-year warranty.
- Source: https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/

**Best for desk use: Satechi 3-in-1 Foldable Qi2 25W ($129.99)**
- Macworld calls it the tallest and most adjustable foldable 3-in-1 it has tested. The iPhone pad has a 160-degree viewing angle, and it folds for travel. It ships with a 45W adapter and UK/EU plugs.
- It is heavier (399g) and bulkier than its travel rivals.
- Source: https://www.macworld.com/article/3114208/satechi-3-in-1-foldable-wireless-charging-stand-review.html

**Fastest for the money: Nomad Stand One Max ($169)**
- 25W Qi2 for the iPhone and a fast Watch charger, in a heavy, classy base. The adapter is not included, so you need a 40W USB-C adapter (Nomad's is $25).
- Source: https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/

**Best budget: ESR Qi2 3-in-1 Wireless Charging Station ($40, marked down from $80 on Amazon)**
- WIRED's pick for cheapest. It charges the iPhone at 15W and includes an adapter. The Apple Watch charger is a separate unit that plugs into the back.
- Source: https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/

**Best for nightstand: Nimble Podium 3-in-1 ($130 on Amazon)**
- The pads lie flat so the screen stays out of sight. It has 25W Qi2 for the iPhone and includes a 36W adapter. The Apple Watch charges slowly, so it is best left overnight.
- Source: https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/

**My pick:** If you have an iPhone 17, 16 Pro Max, or 16 Plus and want 25W, get the ESR CryoBoost. If you have a different iPhone or want to spend less, the Belkin or the $40 ESR is the better choice, since their 15W iPhone speed is about the same as the 25W stands on most phones.
